name: Rhys Llewellyn
bio: Rhys's passion for motorsport ignited at a young age, fueled by watching Welsh rally drivers navigate treacherous courses. He pursued a degree in marketing, specializing in digital media, from Cardiff University. His experience includes internships with local racing teams, managing their social media presence and developing targeted ad campaigns. He thrives on crafting innovative marketing strategies that resonate with motorsport fans and drive brand engagement. Rhys is known for his meticulous approach, ensuring every detail aligns with the team's overall objectives, and his ambition to elevate the team's visibility and market share.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled with a side part.
physical.description: Rhys has a lean build and a perpetually focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a notebook filled with marketing ideas.
Has a habit of tapping his pen when concentrating.
Can recite motorsport trivia for hours.
